package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
	// Short variable declaration (Sangat idiomatik di Go)
	name := "Cloud Engineer"
	version := 1.22

	// Deklarasi standar tanpa nilai awal (Zero Value)
	var requestCount int
	var isReady bool

	fmt.Println("=== Tipe Data dan Variabel ===")
	// %T digunakan untuk mencetak Tipe Data, %v untuk nilainya
	fmt.Printf("Name    : %v (Type: %T)\n", name, name)
	fmt.Printf("Version : %v (Type: %T)\n", version, version)
	
	fmt.Println("\n=== Zero Values ===")
	fmt.Printf("requestCount (int)  : %v\n", requestCount)
	fmt.Printf("isReady (bool)      : %v\n", isReady)
}
